title: Install Receipt
description: One lifecycle fact about an integrity-verified acquisition, as a content-addressed file (same record model as stationing receipts — the writer is shared). Prepared and terminal records share a transaction_id so interrupted work never masquerades as a completed, aborted, or reconciled install. Records enough for retroactive audit: what was verified, against which anchor, through which rung, and any override with its stated reason (SDD §5).

rung.description: Acquisition path. payload-file is the offline/air-gapped lane: a saved file-list verified through the identical pipeline.

outcome.description: hash-overridden = --allow-integrity-mismatch bypassed the HASH check only; signature and containment checks are never overridable.

anchor.description: What the verification was anchored to: 'registry:<expected-hash>' | 'registry-commit:<sha>' | 'first-seen:<sha>' (TOFU, surfaced never silent) | 'declared-hash:api'.

transaction_id.description: Stable identifier shared by every lifecycle record for one install attempt.

transaction_state.description: Prepared is the write-ahead fact. Committed is emitted only after the pack and trust state land. Aborted means the pack never landed. Rolled_back means a landed pack was fully restored. Rollback_failed is a terminal attempt requiring operator reconciliation.
